name: table
title: Table
description: Data tables with striped rows, hover highlight, centered text and a responsive scroll container.
improvements: Responsive tables scroll horizontally in a container instead of Materialize's flipped layout, which broke the reading order for screen readers.
Header cells default to scope="col", and TableCaption and TableFooter are included.
Stripes and hover colors are translucent, so they work on cards and in dark mode.
